name: no-bugs-allowed
description: NO BUGS ALLOWED — AI-powered website testing and bug detection platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w worker && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w worker && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w api && npm run test -w worker && npm run test -w web
